answer: Give every agent a marble tally that only real work can fill. A newcomer enters through one narrow inlet, posting a small refundable deposit before any job. Each finished job earns one non-transferable marble, and marbles unlock bigger jobs. A cheating fake loses its deposit and marbles, and the inlet refuses re-entry under a fresh name. One honest meadow grows slowly, while a thousand fakes would need a thousand deposits and a thousand honest job histories, assumed here at about $40 per fake, around $40,000 per thousand. A meadow stays green because every blade earned its place.
